usage.privacy: Private checkpoint only. Store references rather than sensitive answers. Never store passwords, OTPs, cookies or session tokens.
usage.sections: Replace sample entries with actual observed sections. inspection: uninspected, inspected, unreachable. state: not_started, partial, filled_unsaved, saved, verified, not_applicable.
usage.unresolved_items: Replace sample entry with actual issues, or use an empty array when none. blocked_scope: field, section, application. Unknown requiredness stays null until observed.
usage.handoff: Set ready only after all independent reachable work is done or a documented application-wide gate prevents it. Preserve uninspected pages honestly.
usage.outcome: Use in_progress, Needs user, Blocked, Submitted or Skipped as observed. A checkpoint does not replace dashboard outcome records or prove submission.
